mapper.sql: id, config_key, config_value, data_type, config_group, description, is_secret, is_core, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, version
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_config ORDER BY ${q.orderBy} LIMIT #{q.size} OFFSET #{q.offset}
SELECT FROM sys_config WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT FROM sys_config WHERE config_key = #{key} AND deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_config (config_key, config_value, data_type, config_group, description, is_secret, is_core, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{configKey}, #{configValue}, #{dataType}, #{configGroup}, #{description}, #{isSecret}, 0, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_config SET config_value = #{configValue}, data_type = #{dataType}, config_group = #{configGroup}, description = #{description}, is_secret = #{isSecret}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = NOW(3), version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE sys_config SET deleted = 1, updated_by = #{by}, updated_at = NOW(3), version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND deleted = 0
